title: C_SC_NA_1 with select qualifier
purpose: Exercise the documented common-command qualifier select/execute bit while keeping all other fields identical to the canonical single-command baseline.
expected_behavior: The frame should be parsed as a valid single command, with the final qualifier octet driving the select-form qualifier path instead of the execute-form path.
constraints_preserved: Framing remains identical to the baseline 104 C_SC_NA_1 seed
Only the single command qualifier octet changes
Type_id 45 and cause 6 activation are preserved
One-object VSQ and fixed address widths are preserved
issue_safety_notes: A conservative field-interaction seed varying a documented qualifier bit only.
